text: Soren Lindqvist and Dr. Amara Osei plan exactly where the QAOA circuit runs, and in what order it gets there.
Stage one: Qiskit Aer's ideal, noiseless AerSimulator -- free, fast, and open to unlimited reruns while the circuit gets debugged.
Stage two: real hardware, ibm_brisbane, reached through IBM Quantum's free tier, once the simulator stage looks right.
The standing rule going forward: validate on the simulator first, before spending any real-hardware queue time at all.
Next: Felix Nakamura writes the real classical baseline solver in Python.
